sloka: विचित्रांश्चेरतुर्मार्गान् रुषितौ कपिराक्षसौ ।जघ्नतुश्च तदा ऽन्योन्यं निर्दयं जयकाङ्क्षिणौ ।। ६.५४.३२ ।।।।
transliteration: vicitrāṁśceraturmārgān ruṣitau kapirākṣasau ।jaghnatuśca tadā 'nyonyaṁ nirdayaṁ jayakāṅkṣiṇau ।। 6.54.32 ।।।।

translations.english: Their wounds streaming blood, exhausted in the battlefield, when they rested on their knees on the ground, they were like charming Kimsuka blossoms.
